blocks.content: We now know that the sequence of method calls in the Fibonacci series is not linear but rather resembles a tree.
But method calls/returns still take place sequentially, one after the other.
Here, fib(n - 2) comes after fib(n - 1). So, fib(n - 2) is evaluated only after fib(n - 1) returns a value.
So, the left-hand side must return a value first before calling the method on the right-hand side.
The order in which the calls and returns occur is shown in the figure below.
